title: Resolve same-logical-name project selectors without losing physical evidence
outcome: Project graph tools retain 0.12.71 name-node compatibility when multiple physical rows share one logical name while exposing every physical path and reserving project_ambiguous for genuinel...
acceptance: A selector matching multiple physical rows with one logical project name returns the shared graph node instead of project_ambiguous.
Selectors spanning different logical names still return project_ambiguous, with decisive product tests for both cases.
The response lists every matching physical project path and its distinguishing metadata.
disposal_reason: Superseded by the owner's Option C decision (Greg, 2026-09-04): same-name physical project rows remain separate index rows and are disclosed (project_ambiguous with every physical path; graph/semantic answers are assembly-name-keyed and identical for the listed paths, stated in the response detail). This item's acceptance ('return the shared graph node instead of project_ambiguous') is the opposite of that decision. Shipped in b54a831 (0.12.72) and documented in 21cdaa8 (0.12.74). Reviewer ruling by Phoenix::Fable during the close-out audit; re-open if the owner wants the other behavior.
